A '''tribe''' of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]<ref name="JKTCG2">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=Urur • Tusken Warrior|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/73022/cid/5265193/2001-Decipher-Jedi-Knights-TCG:-Premiere-98-Urur---Tusken-Warrior}}</ref> lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BtM" /> Its members included [[Ur]] and his younger brother, [[Urur]], with the latter having duties restricted to defending the tribe. If Ur was [[Death/Legends|killed]], however, Urur would take his older brother's place.<ref name="JKTCG2" /> At some point by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] was [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|killed]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> before the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|death]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], Ur slew two [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|guards]] during a territorial skirmish with Jabba. The Tusken Raider would become famous for that event.<ref name="JKTCG">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=Ur • Tusken Raider|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/73022/cid/5265192/2001-Decipher-Jedi-Knights-TCG:-Premiere-97-Ur---Tusken-Raider}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ur's tribe was introduced in [[2001]] for the [[Premiere (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Premiere'']] set of the ''[[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]]''.<ref name="JKTCG2" />
